title: Fix Demonstrator Sourcing Pane
description: Aussuchen pane on the demonstrator overview shows Keine Plugins geladen while other five panes preview correctly. Root cause: boot effect false positive from stale loadedPluginsRef after installPlugin.
summary: Fixed a false "Keine Plugins geladen" on the demonstrator Aussuchen pane when six co-mounted shells share one demonstrator plugin worker. installPlugin now returns an explicit outcome; the boot effect only sets noPluginsLoaded on outcome failed (not on stale loadedPluginsRef). establishPrimarySession clears shell error on success. Canvas render checks error before the loading placeholder. Verified with probe-six-panes.mts: all six panes boot on :6029, aussuchen shows sourcing-curate chrome without Keine Plugins geladen.
